adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (lib/topic_retriever.rb:~33-37). `Jobs::PollFeed` is also defined as a scheduled hourly job (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), so this introduces duplicated feed fetching/parsing on-demand for embed requests (only gated by the per-`embed_url` redis throttle in `retrieved_recently?`, not by a feed-level throttle). This is a concrete, diff-grounded performance/architecture concern, not an outright correctness defect.
